title: A Machine for the Echo
author: Astrid Oyelaran
blurb: Sebastian Whitlock, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
